Native 9:16: at most two people side by side; groups (elites, priestesses, guards) are always staged in depth, never in a line across the frame. Every shot line in the prompts carries a "Sides:" note for the top, middle and bottom thirds.

EXT. HARBOR BARRACKS GATE - NIGHT (CONTINUOUS) Characters: Agnivesh, Devika, Royal Guard 3, Royal Sentries, Shadow Hound AGNIVESH stands outside the open gate, his spear planted in the ground, a dead SHADOW HOUND still impaled on it. The golden glow of the SWORD-SHAPED MARK fades beneath his sleeve. DEVIKA and the wounded ROYAL SENTRIES are just inside the gate. ROYAL GUARD 3 runs down the shore road toward them from the Rajmahal. ROYAL GUARD 3 (urgent, breathless) Rajkumar Agnivesh! Humare saath chhal hua hai! Humein is raaste par uljha kar Kaalini apne chhaya-daanavon ke saath Varuna-Dwaar se Rajmahal mein ghus gayi hai! The dead SHADOW HOUND slides off the spear and thuds onto the stones at Agnivesh's feet, dissolving into black smoke. Agnivesh wrenches the spear free. AGNIVESH (urgent, to Devika) Devika, mere saath chalo. Humein jaldi pahunchna hoga, anyatha bahut bada anarth ho jaayega! Agnivesh runs toward the Rajmahal, Devika close behind him. The ROYAL SENTRIES take their positions at the gate. EXT. SURYAGARH RAJMAHAL - COURTYARD - NIGHT (CONTINUOUS) Characters: Agnivesh, Devika, Kaalini, Several Demon Elites The Rajmahal is Suryagarh’s fortified royal palace. High stone walls surround its courtyard. Carved sun emblems mark the walls and gates. Golden ward-lights are fixed above the gates and along the courtyard walls. The courtyard connects to the Surya Mandir, the grand corridor and the throne room. The main gates open on the south side; the steps of the Surya Mandir rise on the east side; on the north side, an arched entrance leads into the Grand Corridor and on to the throne room. KAALINI (30s, pale skin, obsidian hair pinned with serpent ornaments, midnight-blue warrior saree) walks through the open gates. Behind her march the DEMON ELITES: tall warriors in jagged black armour and horned masks, with glowing red eyes, carrying hooked spears. As Kaalini and the Demon Elites pass, the golden ward-lights flicker. Black smoke curls around each light, and they go dark one by one. Agnivesh and Devika rush into the courtyard through an inner passage on the west side and cut across her path at the centre of the courtyard. Agnivesh steps in front of Kaalini and levels his spear. The Demon Elites tighten their grip on their hooked spears, ready to strike. Devika steps up beside him and looks up at the darkening ward-lights. DEVIKA (uneasy, low) Yeh raksha-jyotiyan use rok kyun nahi rahin? Along the walls, the last sun-shaped lights die out. KAALINI (arrogant, venomous) Tumhare Suryagarh ka suraksha-chakra ab mere aage ek bujhi hui raakh hai, Balika. Tumhari prarthana vyarth hai aur tumhara devta vivash. Yahan ab keval mera raaj chalega! Agnivesh looks at the black smoke spreading across the courtyard stones. AGNIVESH (low, to Devika) Raksha-jyotiyan aise hi nahi bujh sakti... Avashya Surya Mandir ke kisi drohi ne bheetar se mantra-bhang kiya hai! Kaalini steps toward Agnivesh and faces him. The Demon Elites stand behind her, spears ready. KAALINI (cold, dismissive) Raasta chhodo, Rajkumar. Ab is mahal par andhkaar ka raaj hoga. AGNIVESH (firm, defiant) Jab tak Agnivesh jeevit hai, singhasan tak pahunchne ka tumhara ye sapna kabhi poora nahi hoga, Kaalini! Behind Kaalini, the Demon Elites point their spears at Agnivesh. Devika stands firm beside him. KAALINI (mocking) Tumhare pita ne tumhara naam mita diya hai, ab tumhara koi adhikaar nahi iss rajya pe. Ab tum keval is mitti par bhatakte hue ek bhikshuk ke samaan ho! Kaalini glances back at her Demon Elites and nods. They turn their hooked spears toward Devika. Devika steps back in fear. Agnivesh steps up beside her and shifts his spear away from Kaalini, pointing it at the Demon Elites. Devika stands firm at his side, unafraid. KAALINI (mocking, to her Demon Elites) Is parajit Rajkumar ka thoda dhyan rakhna, mere veero... Abhi-abhi Suryagarh se nishkaasit hua hai, komal dil hai bechare ka, kahin ro na pade! Kaalini strokes Agnivesh's cheek with mock affection, then walks away toward the Surya Mandir steps on the east side. Her Demon Elites stay, spears levelled at Agnivesh. DEVIKA (urgent) Woh Surya Mandir ki taraf ja rahi hai! Agnivesh replies to Devika in a low voice, his spear still pointed toward the Demon Elites. AGNIVESH (low, urgent) Devika, dev-sevikayon ko surakshit bahar le jao. Main Kaalini ko rokta hoon! Agnivesh pushes back his sleeve. The SWORD-SHAPED MARK on his wrist flares with a blinding golden light. The Demon Elites stagger back, shielding their eyes, and in the confusion Agnivesh and Devika slip away toward the Surya Mandir. INT. SURYA MANDIR - GARBHAGRIHA - NIGHT (CONTINUOUS) Characters: Kaalini, Agnivesh, Devika, Temple Priestess Leader, Several Temple Priestesses, Several Demon Elites The SUN ALTAR stands at the centre of the sanctum, beneath the golden SUN MANDALA on the far wall. The main entrance is at the near end, a side arch opens on the left wall, and a small rear doorway is behind the altar. KAALINI strides into the sanctum as several TEMPLE PRIESTESSES in white-and-gold sarees form a circle around the SUN ALTAR. TEMPLE PRIESTESS LEADER (mid-40s, silver-streaked black hair in a jasmine bun, ivory-and-gold temple-silk drape, crystal mala) stands at the altar, at the head of the circle, and lifts a SACRED SCROLL over it. The priestesses raise brass prayer lamps. Their flames sputter black. The priestesses gasp. The TEMPLE PRIESTESS LEADER turns to the golden SUN MANDALA above the altar and prays. TEMPLE PRIESTESS LEADER (shaking, chanting loudly) Surya Dev, is vipatti, iss andhkaar ko Suryagarh se door kijiye! KAALINI (flat, contemptuous) Apne devta ko pukaarna band karo. Tumhari chikh-pukaar is garbhagriha ki deewaron se bahar nahi jayegi... Yahan ab sirf andhere ka raaj hoga, sirf andhere ka... The priestesses shrink back from Kaalini. AGNIVESH enters through a side arch, Devika behind him, and levels his spear at Kaalini's back. AGNIVESH (deep, forceful) Kaalini, inko haani pahunchaane ki sochna bhi mat. Yeh saare nirdosh hain. Kaalini turns slowly toward Agnivesh. The Demon Elites run in through the main entrance and level their spears at him from behind. KAALINI (mocking, measured) Nirdosh? Mat bhoolo, inki wajah se tumko apshagun kaha jaata hai! While Kaalini's eyes are on Agnivesh, Devika quietly leads the temple priestesses toward the rear doorway behind the altar. DEVIKA (low, urgent) Sab log is raaste se niklo, abhi! The TEMPLE PRIESTESS LEADER runs alongside Devika. At the rear doorway, she turns and calls back to Kaalini. TEMPLE PRIESTESS LEADER (voice breaking, defiant) Jab tak Surya vansh ki jyoti jal rahi hai, tumhara andhkaar nahi jeetega! Kaalini smiles. She draws her SERPENT DAGGER and hurls it. It slashes across the Priestess Leader's throat. A prayer lamp falls from her hand and rolls across the marble. The TEMPLE PRIESTESS LEADER collapses in the doorway. Agnivesh rushes to the rear doorway and sinks to one knee beside the fallen Priestess Leader. AGNIVESH (voice deep, restrained) Tumne ek rakshak ko nahi maara, Kaalini. Tumne Suryagarh ke pavitra man-mastisk mein vaar kiya hai. KAALINI (quiet, cruel) Abhi toh shuruaat hai, Rajkumar... Aaj tumhare devta, tumhara astitva, aur yeh poora Suryagarh mere andhere mein vileen ho jayega! Kaalini's dagger slithers back across the marble like a serpent, rises into the air, and she catches it. She licks the blood off its blade and turns to her Demon Elites. KAALINI (sharp, commanding) Mere veero, iss ashubh rajkumar ko chhodo aur aage badho! The Demon Elites turn and rush out of the temple toward the Grand Corridor. Kaalini follows them. Agnivesh stays on his knees beside the fallen Priestess Leader. Devika leads the surviving priestesses to safety. INT. RAJMAHAL - GRAND CORRIDOR - NIGHT (CONTINUOUS) Characters: Agnivesh, Devika, Kaalini, Rajguru Badrinath, Several Demon Elites, Several Shadow Warriors, Several Royal Guards The long corridor runs from the courtyard arch to the throne-room doors at the far end, lined with sun-carved pillars, with royal guards posted before the doors. RAJGURU BADRINATH (bald, flame-and-lotus scalp tattoo, white beard, saffron robes) stands beside a sun-carved pillar near the corridor's entrance as Kaalini enters. RAJGURU BADRINATH lowers his eyes and steps aside as Kaalini and her Demon Elites pass. Agnivesh runs in. He spots RAJGURU BADRINATH near the pillar and stops short. AGNIVESH (strained, respectful) Rajguru Badrinath, aap yahan khade kyun hain? Use rokiye! Badrinath presses his prayer beads between both palms. He faces Agnivesh without lifting his head. RAJGURU BADRINATH (low, trembling) Maine hi Kaalini ka raasta khola tha. Agar main aisa nahi karta toh Timiraksha mere poore parivaar ko maar deta. Agnivesh takes one hard step toward him. AGNIVESH (deep, wounded) Aapne is rajya ki raksha ki kasam khaayi thi. Aur aapne apne parivaar ko bachane ke liye... Suryagarh ke hazaaron parivaaron ki jaan khatre mein daal di. Rajguru Badrinath lowers his head, unable to answer. Kaalini reaches the middle of the corridor. Her Demon Elites rush ahead, forcing the royal guards aside. Agnivesh charges after her, spear raised. Several Demon Elites turn and lock their hooked spears together, blocking his way. Agnivesh strikes the spear-wall, trying to break through, but they hold firm. Devika rushes into the corridor after guiding the surviving priestesses to safety. Kaalini kneels and cuts a mark into the marble with her serpent dagger. A black, blood-like seal spreads across the floor. KAALINI (low, chanting) Rakta se bandho. Surya ki shakti bujha do. DEVIKA (shouting to Agnivesh) Agnivesh! Uska rakta-bandhan bhang karo! Yeh singhasan ki shakti kheench rahi hai! Agnivesh pushes against the Demon Elites’ spears. AGNIVESH (straining, furious) Kaalini! Suryagarh ki mitti par tera yeh andhera kabhi nahi tikne doonga main! Kaalini stands and lifts her dagger for all to see. KAALINI (triumphant) Tumhare rajya ka ant ho chuka hai, rajya se nikaale hue Rajkumar! Timiraksha apna raj-bali lene aa raha hai! Black smoke spreads beneath the throne room doors. The guards at the far end step back in fear. AGNIVESH (desperate, fierce) Maharaj ko haani pahunchaane ki sochna bhi mat... Mere pita ko kuch hua toh tumhare poore andhere ke saamrajya ko jala ke raakh kar dunga! Kaalini turns toward the throne room and raises her hand. KAALINI (calling out, triumphant) Maharaj Someshwar… Timiraksha aapke liye aa raha hai! The throne-room doors BLAST off their hinges and crash across the corridor. The Demon Elites are thrown to the floor. Black smoke pours through the broken doorway. Tall, lean Shadow Warriors emerge from it, their bodies covered in shifting black armour. Violet eyes glow through their masks, and curved blades extend from their hands. The Demon Elites rise and gather behind Kaalini. Black smoke wraps around them. Their heavy armour changes shape, turning dark and smoke-like as they join the Shadow Warriors’ ranks. The royal guards step back in fear. One drops his spear. Devika moves behind a stone pillar. Agnivesh sees Kaalini near the open throne-room doorway. He breaks free of the spear-wall and runs toward her as the Shadow Warriors close in behind her. HARD CUT

Corridor: echoing footsteps, iron on iron, the seal's wet spreading hiss under Kaalini's chant, the boom of the doors, blades sliding out of forearms.

SCRIPT:
0–5 SEC | VISUAL: Rajmahal ka shahi kaksh. Devika dulhan ke laal vastron mein khadi hai. Agnivesh uske saamne vivaah ka taadpatra rakhta hai.
AGNIVESH: "Yeh vivaah keval ek raat ke liye hoga!"
5–11 SEC | VISUAL: Devika Agnivesh ke kareeb aati hai. Uska haath thaamkar apni kamar par rakhti hai.
DEVIKA (Dheemi Awaaz): "Aur agar ek raat mein mujhe tumse prem ho gaya toh?"

16–20 SEC | NARRATOR: "Ek dulhan... do rajkumar! Aakhir kiski hogi Devika?"

IOC2 - DIRECTOR'S MANUAL (Ek Dulhan, Do Rajkumar) - 20 sec

1. THEME / PREMISE

A one-night marriage pact turns into a love triangle. Agnivesh offers Devika a vivaah taadpatra valid for only one night; Devika tests him with a soft confession; Ranvijay bursts in with his sword to stop it. Hook question for the audience: "Aakhir kiski hogi Devika?"

2. VISUAL STYLE & FRAMING

16:9 frame, all key action and faces kept inside the centre 9:16 safe area. Royal Indian period look, warm diya and mashaal light inside the Rajmahal Royal Chamber, deep reds and gold. Devika in red bridal vastra and jewellery; Agnivesh and Prince Ranvijay exactly as their approved character assets. Camera: smooth mechanical moves only (slow dolly, push-in, slow arc, tilt). No handheld, no whip-pans, no crash zooms. Every shot has gentle motion.

3. NARRATIVE STRUCTURE / PACING

0-5s: Setup. Shahi kaksh. Devika stands in bridal red. Agnivesh places the Marriage Scroll (taadpatra) in front of her. AGNIVESH: "Yeh vivaah keval ek raat ke liye hoga!"

5-11s: Intimacy. Devika steps close, takes his hand and places it on her waist. DEVIKA (soft voice): "Aur agar ek raat mein mujhe tumse prem ho gaya toh?"

11-16s: Rupture. Agnivesh looks into her eyes. The chamber door bangs open. Ranvijay stands in the doorway holding the Royal sword. RANVIJAY: "Devika! Tum mere bhai ki patni nahi ban sakti!"

16-20s: Hook. Hold on the three of them. NARRATOR: "Ek dulhan... do rajkumar! Aakhir kiski hogi Devika?"

4. SCENE-BY-SCENE EMOTION

0-5s: Agnivesh calm, guarded, formal. Devika composed, curious.

5-11s: Devika tender, daring; Agnivesh still, caught off guard.

11-16s: Shock. Ranvijay furious and possessive; Devika startled; Agnivesh turns to face him, protective.

16-20s: Tension frozen; triangle composition, Devika in the centre.

5. DIEGETIC SOUND

No music. SFX only: diya flame crackle, soft rustle of bridal fabric and bangles, scroll unrolling on wood, footsteps, heavy door slamming open, sword ring. Narrator voice-over only in 16-20s.

6. TRANSITIONS & CONTINUITY ANCHORS

One continuous location: Rajmahal Royal Chamber. The chamber door is the single entry point; Ranvijay enters only through it.

Positions lock: Agnivesh frame-left, Devika frame-right facing him for 0-11s; when the door opens Ranvijay appears in the background doorway, and in 16-20s the triangle reads Agnivesh left, Devika centre, Ranvijay right. Keep these sides the same in every shot.

Marriage Scroll stays where Agnivesh placed it for the rest of the IOC.

7. DERIVATIVE ASSET PRE-PLAN

Characters: Devika (bridal red look), Agnivesh, Prince Ranvijay. Location: Rajmahal Royal Chamber. Props: Marriage Scroll, Royal sword (in Ranvijay's hand). No other new assets needed.

8. NINNI'S DIRECTOR RULES (apply to every track)

- Dialogue is used exactly as written in the script, word for word. No rewording, no added or removed lines.

- Only the speaking character's mouth moves on their line; everyone else keeps their mouth closed.

- Every shot carries a Positions line; character sides and screen direction stay locked from shot to shot and from track to track. No character suddenly changes side, turns around or faces the wrong way.

- Characters look at the person they are talking to.

- The rendered location must match the location asset exactly, used as the background plate. No invented or redesigned layout, no mixing of conflicting location refs.

- Add every relevant existing asset (each character, location and prop in the shot) as a reference.

- Shot size and camera move follow the Storyboard Table. Shots, shot order and framing are not changed once approved.

- No eye glow on any character.

- Never regenerate an approved asset unless Ninni asks. Devika is never regenerated.

Director Creative Plan: The Royal Darbar Awakening
① Theme, Intent, and Narrative Core
Core Theme: Dynastic arrogance and public humiliation collapse the moment an outcast prince's dormant solar bloodline awakens to claim sovereign authority.
Emotional Through-Line:
Layer 1 (Subjugation & Derision): Crushing social intimidation, marked by heavy armored strides, a drawn blade cast across polished marble, and derisive sneers.
Layer 2 (Suppressed Stillness): Unyielding physical composure; lowered eyelids, relaxed shoulders, and complete muscular stillness absorbing hostile insults without flinching.
Layer 3 (Transcendent Vindication): Seismic inversion of power; dilated pupils, rising chin, and absolute stillness as the crown floats upward to crown true authority.
Parting Impression & Emotional Strategy: Absolute catharsis and breathless vindication. The audience must feel the sudden shift from suffocating humiliation to sovereign dominance, leaving a cliffhanger hook at the exact peak of divine reclamation.
② Visual Style and Frame Tone
Compositional Style (Vertical 9:16 Priority):
Symmetrical Center-Weighting: Agnivesh is anchored dead-center in the lower third of the vertical frame, creating an immovable pillar of calm against the volatile court.
Oppressive Diagonal Staging: Ranvijay is composed along a descending diagonal from upper-left to center, leaning into Agnivesh's space to project predatory entitlement.
Vertical Hierarchical Stacking: Someshwar is framed from a steep low angle looking up toward the elevated dais, stacking the throne, canopy, and crown above Agnivesh to emphasize institutional tyranny.
Three-Layer Spatial Separation:
Foreground: The skidding talwar blade scraping the floor tiles / dust falling from ceiling cornices (leading the viewer's eye into the confrontation).
Midground: The primary narrative combatants (Ranvijay leaning over Agnivesh; Someshwar's outstretched accusing hand; Agnivesh's glowing wrist).
Background: Towering carved sandstone pillars, rows of smirking courtiers, and heavy crimson silk drapes framing the elevated throne dais.
Camera Movement Preference:
Predominantly locked and deliberate camera moves driven strictly by narrative beats.
Rapid crane push-in on the flung blade to establish violent momentum.
Quick, disorienting handheld pan across mocking noblemen to simulate public encirclement.
Micro-push into Agnivesh's eyes to capture internal control.
Ascending vertical tilt tracking the levitating crown to formally break the court's physical hierarchy.
③ Narrative Structure and Pacing Plan
Narrative Mode Selection: Source-Faithful Microdrama Adaptation (7 continuous shots / 15 seconds, engineered around a tight humiliation-to-reversal structure).
Section Division:



Section	Name	Shots	Core Event	Emotional Intensity	Pacing
Section 1	The Public Humiliation	Shots 1–4	Ranvijay casts down his blade and demands subjugation; Someshwar denounces Agnivesh	Rising tension (5/10 → 8/10)	Rapid, punchy dialogue & hostile cuts
Section 2	The Solar Awakening	Shots 5–7	The wrist mark blazes; palace trembles; rajmukut levitates; Agnivesh claims his divine heritage	Climax & Reversal (9/10 → 10/10)	Kinetic punch-in expanding to suspended slow-motion
Emotional Curve: Sharp compression of space and mounting psychological hostility across Shots 1–4, breaking into an abrupt acoustic drop and expanding into sovereign majesty across Shots 5–7.
Fast / Slow Pacing: Shots 1–4 maintain rapid cutting on dialogue hits and mocking reactions (~2.5s per beat); Shots 5–7 slow physical motion down to capture telekinetic weight and structural vibration while maintaining high visual density.
Key Turning Points:
Turning Point 1 (Shot 4 to 5): Cut from Someshwar's condemning finger directly to an extreme close-up of Agnivesh's inner wrist, where dormant dermal fissures split open into radiant gold as ceiling dust jars loose above.
Turning Point 2 (Shot 5 to 6): The physical detachment of the rajmukut rising unassisted from the throne cushion into mid-air, reversing the monarch's supreme status without a weapon drawn.
Inter-Section Transition: Abrupt hard cut from court laughter to absolute dead silence punctuated by a seismic sub-bass tremor and the ignition of the solar mark.
④ Per-Scene Emotion and Frame Intent
Scene 1: Rajmahal Throne Room (Shots 1–7)
Emotional Target: The cruel triumph of court bullies collapsing into paralyzed dread as the outcast's motionless gaze forces the dynasty's sacred crown into airborne submission.
Atmosphere Direction: Oppressive, suffocating, volatile, transitioning abruptly into awe-inspiring, transcendent, and regal.
Shot Intent:
Shot 1 (Establishing Clash): Plunge from a high crane down to floor level as the heavy talwar slides toward the lens, instantly establishing Ranvijay's predatory entitlement and placing the audience at floor level.
Shot 2 (Verbal Assault): Low-angle medium close-up on Ranvijay's sneering mouth, cutting to eye-level medium close-up on Agnivesh's unblinking, relaxed expression to contrast rabid arrogance with unshakeable discipline.
Shot 3 (Court Mockery): Handheld lateral pan across smirking courtiers before pushing into Agnivesh's lowered eyes, emphasizing solitary isolation against an entire hostile institution.
Shot 4 (Patriarchal Condemnation): Over-the-shoulder perspective from behind Agnivesh facing the towering throne dais as Someshwar points downward, framing the crushing weight of royal law bearing down on him.
Shot 5 (Dermal Ignition & Tremor): Extreme macro close-up on the inner wrist as skin lines illuminate with golden fire, followed by a wide snap of swaying chandeliers and falling masonry to prove his bloodline commands the building itself.
Shot 6 (Crown Levitation): Slow-motion vertical tilt following the spinning gold crown lifting away from the empty throne, while courtiers physically stumble back into pillars.
Shot 7 (Sovereign Proclamation): Heroic low-angle close-up pushing into Agnivesh's raised eyes with the crown hovering above his head, cementing his reclamation of divine lineage on the cliffhanger line.
Spatial Narrative: Complete inversion of vertical power. The scene begins with Ranvijay and Someshwar dominating the upper two-thirds of the frame, looking down upon an isolated subject. It ends with the floating crown establishing a new apex above Agnivesh, forcing the throne and court to gaze upward.
Distance Design: Wide establishing slide (3m) → claustrophobic medium close-up confrontation (0.5m) → macro insert on wrist (zero distance) → wide structural shudder (10m) → heroic vertical close-up.
⑤ Sound Direction
Ambient Sound Design:
Heavy armored combat boots grinding on polished marble.
Ringing metallic slide and reverberant brassy clang of Damascus steel scraping stone flagstones.
Murmur of courtiers breaking into layered derisive snickers, whispers, and haughty guffaws.
Deep tectonic sub-bass shudder vibrating through stone footings.
Chandelier brass chains clashing and crystal pendants jingling violently overhead.
Fine masonry dust pattering onto silk robes and flagstones.
Shimmering crystalline ringing tone hummed by the spinning levitated crown.
Use of Silence: Complete cessation of all court laughter and murmurs at the exact opening frame of Shot 5; the ambient acoustic space goes dead silent for a fraction of a second, leaving only a solitary sub-bass heartbeat pulse before the seismic rumble erupts.
⑥ Transitions and Visual Continuity
Inter-Scene Transition Strategy: Rapid hard cuts between verbal strikes and listener reactions; axial jump-in from medium close-up to extreme macro insert for the awakening beat.
Inter-Section Transition Technique: Audio-motivated hard cut; the sudden drop into silence and the sharp high-frequency hum of the activating wrist mark bridges court ridicule into supernatural manifestation.
Visual Continuity Anchors:
Ranvijay's curved talwar remains stationary on the marble floor at Agnivesh's boots across Shots 1–5.
Agnivesh maintains locked vertical posture with arms resting at his sides, blue silk angrakha cuffs intact until the right sleeve shifts slightly to reveal the glowing mark in Shot 5.
Someshwar's outstretched right arm and pointing index finger maintain direction and eyeline alignment across Shots 4–5.
The rajmukut's starting position on the throne dais cushion before ascending vertically along the central architectural axis in Shot 6.

Royal Courtiers	formal courtier attire	Default on-screen formal courtier costume for the royal assembly throughout Shots 1–6.
Ranvijay's Sword	ground resting state	The curved Damascus talwar lying flat on polished marble after being flung down, visible in Shots 1–5.

① Theme, Intent, and Narrative Core
Core Theme: A publicly disgraced prince transforms parental condemnation into sovereign vindication through the unyielding oath of maternal destiny.
Emotional Through-Line:
Layer 1 (Public Humiliation & Suppressed Grief): Physical recoil, staggered footsteps backward across raked sand, downward eye-cast, jaw muscle trembling while swallowing back tears under public condemnation.
Layer 2 (Maternal Memory & Sacred Anchor): Upright spinal alignment, deep inhalation, palm flattening against lower abdomen mirroring the remembered maternal touch, tear film locking at eyelid margins without spilling.
Layer 3 (Karmic Defiance & Sovereign Vindication): Brow lowers, teeth grind, fingers tighten into rigid fists as golden solar energy surges through wrist veins, planted stance locking forward against patriarchal authority.
Parting Impression & Expression Strategy: Sudden reversal from humiliation to awe; the oppressive patriarch stumbles backward while the rejected son dominates the vertical frame as an awakened sovereign protector.
② Visual Style and Frame Tone
Compositional Style (Vertical 9:16 Staging):
Symmetrical Central Framing: Reserved for Maharaja Someshwar's royal decree and Maharani's maternal vow to anchor immovable moral and dynastic authority.
Diagonal Tension Composition: Applied during Maharaja Someshwar's physical shove, tilting the visual axis across the upper-right to lower-left corridor to register violent destabilization.
Tight Frame-within-a-Frame: Sandstone pillars and flanking royal canopies box Agnivesh into narrow vertical strips, isolating him visually against the sneering assembly.
Three-Layer Spatial Separation:
Foreground (Eye-Lead): Clenched knuckles, edge of heavy peacock-teal brocade, or brass prayer vessels blurred at lens perimeter (0.3–0.5m).
Midground (Narrative Subject): Dominant character faces and chest-to-waist interactions centered within vertical constraints (1.5–2.5m).
Background (Atmosphere & Reaction): Ring of hostile courtiers, towering carved stone facades, or eclipse-shadowed sanctum colonnades (4.0–8.0m).
Camera Movement Preference:
Locked-off framing for static institutional tension; rapid crash push-in on Agnivesh's face when the verbal curse lands.
Rapid vertical tilt downward tracking from Maharaja Someshwar's thrusting palm to Agnivesh's heels skidding in sand.
Fast linear push-in to wrist level as divine flame erupts, holding eye-level lock for the climactic standoff.
③ Narrative Structure and Pacing Plan
Narrative Mode Selection: Source-faithful vertical short-form microdrama adaptation, structured around an immediate 3-second conflict hook, emotional maternal pivot, volcanic power awakening, and unresolved cliffhanger.
Section Division & Step Schedule:



Step / Section	Timecode	Name	Scene Location	Core Event	Emotional Intensity	Pacing	Dependencies
Step 1	00:00–00:05 (5s)	The Humiliation Hook	Royal Tournament Pavilion	Maharaja Someshwar violently shoves Agnivesh and brands him an accursed matricide	8/10	Kinetic; fast cuts (~1.5s/cut)	None (Root / Cold Open Hook)
Step 2	00:05–00:10 (5s)	The Sacred Memory Pivot	High Sun Temple	Flashback: Pregnant Maharani blesses unborn Agnivesh during eclipse night	6/10	Measured; steady push-in (~2.5s/shot)	Step 1 (Triggered by Agnivesh's recoil and tear glaze)

Step Dependencies & Causal Architecture:
Step 1 (Root Hook): Independent cold open. Someshwar's violent physical shove and verbal condemnation ("Tu beta nahi, ek kala shraap hai!") establish the foundational humiliation debt and emotional deficit.
Step 2 (Dependent on Step 1): Direct causal consequence of Agnivesh's physical recoil and tear glazing at eyelid margin in Step 1. Match cut on the tear transports into the eclipse night memory at High Sun Temple, establishing his internal sacred anchor.
Step 3 (Dependent on Step 2): Direct causal consequence of Maharani's maternal vow ("Mere putra... ek din tum is rajya ki raksha karoge!"). The memory resolves filial grief into righteous sovereign awakening, sparking the right-wrist golden fire eruption and sympathetic chain ignition of the brass Prayer Lamps.
Step 4 (Dependent on Step 3): Direct causal consequence of Step 3's divine flame manifestation and flaring lamps. The radiant energy presence physically forces Someshwar off-balance into a recoil, cementing the unresolved power-reversal cliffhanger.
Key Turning Points (Visual Means):
Turn 1 (Violence to Internal Agony): Physical backward stumble cuts abruptly to an extreme close-up of Agnivesh's pupil contracting as tears glaze the iris.
Turn 2 (Memory Match Cut): Direct match cut from Maharani's hand resting over her womb to Agnivesh's hand clamping over his own wrist.
Turn 3 (Status Reversal): Jump cut from low-angle isolated shot of Agnivesh to a Dutch-angle medium shot of Maharaja Someshwar staggering backward as fire ignites.
④ Per-Scene Emotion and Frame Intent
Scene 1: Royal Tournament Pavilion (00:00–00:05)
Emotional Target: Scorching public indignity; physical shock of paternal rejection before a courtly crowd.
Atmosphere Direction: Oppressive, hostile, brutal, claustrophobic.
Shot Intent: High-angle medium shot looking down at Agnivesh as Maharaja Someshwar shoves his chest, cutting immediately to a tight low-angle close-up on Maharaja Someshwar's sneering jaw to visually establish crushing dominance.
Spatial Narrative: Maharaja Someshwar elevated on carved stone dais steps; Agnivesh cast down onto raw arena sand.
Distance Design: Begins at medium distance (2.5m) showing public isolation, collapsing instantly into an intrusive extreme close-up (0.4m) on Agnivesh's quivering jaw.
Scene 2: High Sun Temple — Flashback (00:05–00:10)
Emotional Target: Unshakeable maternal devotion; quiet solemnity cutting through shame.
Atmosphere Direction: Sacred, solemn, intimate, mythic.
Shot Intent: Center-aligned medium close-up tracking Maharani's palm descending onto her pregnant belly, forcing the viewer to register the maternal blessing as an unbreakable binding oath.
Spatial Narrative: Maharani centered between massive sandstone sanctum pillars beneath the open roof oculus, positioned as the singular moral anchor of the lineage.
Distance Design: Zero-distance tactile intimacy; palm-to-belly contact filling the lower third of the vertical frame.
Scene 3: Royal Tournament Pavilion (00:10–00:15)
Emotional Target: Volcanic vindication; total conversion of filial grief into divine authority.
Atmosphere Direction: Mythic, triumphant, electrified, awe-inspiring.
Shot Intent: Extreme close-up of Agnivesh's right wrist as golden energy snakes along the tendons, cutting rapidly to medium reaction inserts of surrounding brass Prayer Lamps flaring into tall flame.
Spatial Narrative: Agnivesh rises to full height, claiming the central vertical axis; court figures in the background blur and step backward into peripheral shadow.
Distance Design: Microscopic detail (wrist vein/energy surge) punching out to a commanding chest-up medium shot at eye-level lock.
Scene 4: Royal Tournament Pavilion (00:15–00:18)
Emotional Target: Sovereign defiance and impending karmic reckoning.
Atmosphere Direction: Suspended tension, climactic, confrontational.
Shot Intent: Low-angle medium-close two-shot with Agnivesh held sharp in foreground left, his glowing hand held forward, while an off-balance Maharaja Someshwar retreats into midground right.
Spatial Narrative: Complete inversion of initial power geometry; the disgraced son now towers visually over the patriarch.
Distance Design: Maintained steady confrontation distance (1.2m), locking the viewer into direct eye contact with Agnivesh before the abrupt episode cut.
⑤ Sound Direction
Ambient Sound Design:
Scene 1 (Royal Tournament Pavilion): Muffled crowd rumble, harsh scraping of leather boots on stone gravel, violent rustle of silk angrakha upon shove impact.
Scene 2 (High Sun Temple): Deep stone hall acoustic resonance, distant low wind through roof oculus, hollow metallic vibration of distant temple bell.
Scene 3 (Royal Tournament Pavilion): Sharp whoosh of kinetic flame ignition, crackling hiss of bursting Prayer Lamp wicks, collective sharp intake of breath from courtiers.
Scene 4 (Royal Tournament Pavilion): Low sustained hum of concentrated energy, heavy boot heel grinding back on sand, heavy silence falling across the spectator tiers.
Use of Silence:
Complete audio dropout (deadening all crowd noise) for 0.8 seconds precisely when Maharaja Someshwar delivers the word "shraap", isolating only Agnivesh's shuddering inhalation.
Sudden ambient cut when golden flame first breaks through Agnivesh's wrist skin, leaving only the pure physical hiss of ignition.
⑥ Transitions and Visual Continuity
Inter-Scene Transition Strategy:
Scene 1 to Scene 2: Match cut on Agnivesh's tear caught at the eyelid to the shadow crossing Maharani's folded hands in High Sun Temple flashback.
Scene 2 to Scene 3: Hard flash cut from Maharani's resting palm directly to Agnivesh's clenching fist in present day.
Scene 3 to Scene 4: Continuous hard spatial cut holding the strict 180-degree axis between Agnivesh and Maharaja Someshwar.
Visual Continuity Anchors:
Costume State: Agnivesh's deep royal-blue silk angrakha and silver breastplate intact; dust streak on left shoulder remaining across Scenes 1, 3, and 4.
Prop State: Maharaja Someshwar's Golden Crown of Suryagarh and gem signet rings consistent during shove and recoil; brass Prayer Lamps positioned along sandstone pedestals.
Anatomical Anchor: Agnivesh's golden flame pattern locked precisely along the radial artery of his right wrist and forearm.

Show: Ultimate Warrior
Episode: IOCSCRIPT1_V1
Title: Suryagarh Shrapit Shishu

SCRIPT:
1st ioc

SCENE 1 – SURYAGARH RAJMAHAL – NIGHT
VISUAL: Hazaaron saal purana Suryagarh ka bhavya rajmahal. Aasmaan mein bijli kadak rahi hai. Camera mahal ki oonchi deewaron se hota hua ek shahi kaksh mein pahunchta hai.

NARRATOR (Deep, Mysterious Voice):

“Hazaaron saal pehle... Suryagarh ke Maharaj Someshwar ne apni hi Maharani ke saath kiya ek aisa vishwasghaat... jisne poore Suryavansh ka bhagya badal diya!”

VISUAL: Maharaj Someshwar ek khoobsurat daasi ke kareeb khade hain. Raja uska haath pakadkar apne paas kheenchta hai. Dono ek-doosre ki aankhon mein dekhte hain. Camera dheere-dheere jalti hui mashaal ki taraf ghoomta hai.

NARRATOR:

“Maharani se chhipkar... Maharaj ne apni hi ek daasi ke saath bana liye avaidh sambandh!”

VISUAL: Samay beetne ka cinematic transition. Daasi apne garbh par haath rakhe khadi hai. Raja uske saamne chintit nazar aa raha hai.

DAASI (Khushi aur darr ke saath):

“Maharaj... main aapke bachche ki maa banne wali hoon!”

RAJA SOMESHWAR (Sakht Awaaz):

“Yeh baat rajmahal ki deewaron se baahar nahi jaani chahiye! Tumhara bachcha isi mahal mein palega... lekin uske janm ka satya kisi ko pata nahi chalega!”
SCENE 3 – GUPT PRASAV KAKSH – STORMY NIGHT
VISUAL: Andheri raat. Baahar bhayankar toofaan. Daasi ek shishu ko janm deti hai. Bachche ke rone ki awaaz poore kaksh mein goonj uthti hai.

NARRATOR:

“Lekin jis raat us daasi ne Maharaj ke bachche ko janm diya... usi raat Maharaj ne rach diya ek bhayankar shadyantra!”

VISUAL: Raja apni talwar nikaalta hai. Daasi apne navjaat bachche ko seene se laga leti hai.

DAASI (Darte hue):

“Maharaj! Aapne toh mere bachche ko apnaane ka vachan diya tha!”

RAJA SOMESHWAR (Krodh mein):

“Ek daasi ka putra kabhi Suryagarh ka waaris nahi ban sakta!”

VISUAL: Raja talwar se prahaar karta hai. Camera daasi ke chehre se tezi se jalti mashaal par cut hota hai. Mashaal bujh jaati hai. Daasi ka nishchet haath zameen par girta hai.

SFX: Talwar ki goonj. Bijli ki kadak.
SCENE 4 – SHRAPIT SHISHU KA RAHASYA – CONTINUOUS
NARRATOR (Intense):

“Apne paap ko hamesha ke liye chhipane ke liye... Maharaj ne us navjaat shishu ko bhi maarne ka faisla kar liya!”

VISUAL: Raja rote hue bachche ke upar talwar uthaata hai.

RAJA SOMESHWAR:

“Tere saath hi mere is paap ka ant ho jayega!”

VISUAL: Jaise hi talwar bachche ki taraf badhti hai, shishu ke shareer se bhayankar sunahri aur laal divya prakash phoot padta hai. Ek adrishya shakti talwar ko rok deti hai. Talwar tukde-tukde hokar bikhar jaati hai.

Raja zor se peeche ja girta hai.

SFX: Divine energy blast. Temple bells. Thunder.

RAJA SOMESHWAR (Bhaybheet):

“Yeh... yeh kaise sambhav hai?!”

VISUAL: Bachche ke maathe par ek rahasyamayi shraap-chihn chamakne lagta hai. Kaksh ki saari mashaalen apne aap jal uthti hain.

RAHASYAMAYI AAKASHVANI (Heavy Echoing Voice):

“Someshwar! Yeh koi saadhaaran shishu nahi... yeh ek shraapit santaan hai! Iska vadh karna kisi ke vash mein nahi!”
SCENE 5 – FINAL HOOK
VISUAL: Raja ki aankhon mein bhay. Camera dheere-dheere bachche ke chamakte hue maathe par zoom karta hai. Bachcha achanak rona band kar deta hai aur apni aankhein kholta hai. Uski aankhon mein sunahri agni chamak uthti hai.

NARRATOR (Powerful Cliffhanger):

“Aakhir kaun tha yeh shraapit bachcha?

Emotional Target: Suppressed sovereign panic hardening into cold tyranny; cornered vulnerability from the maidservant.

Emotional Target: Paralyzing dread and cosmic suspense.

# Episode 13.1 — Script tab (V1), verbatim

Characters: Durvasa, Indra, Gandaberunda, Airavata, Devta 1 & 2, 10 Devtas, Asura Leader, Asura Soldier, Asura Army.

## 1-1 — DEV LOK — DAY / EXT.

The golden divine rivers turn into golden mist that rises into the air leaving behind a dead landscape.

The lotus in the pond dry up and turn into golden dust that scatters.

The golden waterways darken into black glass.

The gold from the monumental structures detaches and turns into golden dust energy that flows towards the Dev lok gates.

Devlok lies in unnatural shadow, its gold collapsed to slate-grey and dull bronze.

## 1-2 — RAJ SABHA — CONTINUOUS / INT.

Near the throne platform, Airavata's is sitting on the floor feeling restless, his head droops.

Indra steps toward him, hand hovering short of the trunk.

INDRA Airavat…ye kya ho rha hai tumhe

Airavata gives a strained rumble. His trunk rises weakly, then sags.

Indra then touches Airawat's crown. The central gem oh his ornament flickers and dies. The aghast Devtas look at Airawat in shock.

INDRA Ye maine kya anarth kar diya! Shri ke saath, Devlok ki saari shakti bhi ja rahi hai.

Devta 1 steps forward and raises his palm. A magical energy golden flame sputters from his palm and shrivels into grey smoke. He stares at his empty palm in subtle panic and fear.

DEVTA 1 Meri shakti… Meri shakti kahan chali gayi?

Beside him, Devta 2 shuts his eyes and chants silently. He opens his eyes, frightened.

DEVTA 2 Main apni divya shakti nahi jaga paa raha!"

Indra turns to Durvasa, trembling.

INDRA ((helpless)) Maharishi…Kripya kuch kijiye. Nhi toh mera ye Devlok, mere saare Devtao ki shakti nast ho jayegi.

All ten Devtas look to Durvasa, pleading.

From the gloom behind Durvasa, Gandaberunda manifests, black wings unfurling. Indra stumbles back looking at the monumental figure of gandaberunda..

GANDABERUNDA Har tabaahi ke liye…Shraap dena zaroori nahi hota, Devraj Indra

Indra stares in horror. The Devtas follow his gaze and see nothing, they look at each other feeling confused.

Indra stares at Gandaberunda as it approches him slowly.

INDRA ye kaun hai Maharishi, kahin isine aapko shraap dene ke liye toh nhi uksaya na

Gandaberunda laughs, rattling the chandeliers, then dissolves into the shadow behind Durvasa.

GANDABERUNDA Kitna bhi prayatna kar le Indra, Tumhara Devlok ab nhi bachega.

INDRA Maharishi…Meri baat suniye. Aapka apmaan karne ka iraada nahi tha mera. Mujhse galti hui hai.

Indra's gaze sweeps the ruin. Durvasa's follows: fallen diya lamps, Devtas slumped on the stairs, Airavata breathing heavily seated with his head drooping and ears flapping.

INDRA Lekin agar meri galti ki saza deni hai…toh mujhe dijiye. Devlok ko nahi.

Behind him, Gandaberunda re-emerges, chuckling that startles Indra.

GANDABERUNDA Sun raha hai, Durvasa? Indra khud maan raha hai ki galti hui hai.

Indra senses a presence and turns to the empty air behind Durvasa, palms joined. The Devtas edge away.

INDRA ((joins hands towards Gandaberunda)) Bas kijiye, aap jo bhi hai...mein aapke haath joddta hun, aap kripya maun raheyea

Gandaberunda steps close to Indra. Indra shivers but sees nothing.

GANDABERUNDA Ab kis baat ka gussa, Indra? Jab Devlok ki roshni hi nahi bachi…toh tera rajya bhi kitni der bachega?

Indra's legs give out and he drops to the floor in front of Durvasa.

Durvasa looks up as the light coming through the large windwos.

DURVASA (V.O.) Ek pal ka Krodha…aur aaj poora Devlok uska bojh utha raha hai.

He glances at the ashes of the garland on the floor in front of him. A breeze carries it away.

DURVASA (V.O.) Maine apni Vani ko roka tha…par karm se kaun bach paya hai.

Gandaberunda smirks, his wings settling behind the sage like a second shadow.

## 1-3 — DARK MOUNTAIN / EXT.

Hundreds of thousands of Asuras stand in spiked armor with spears, maces and cleavers. Bone-plated chariots are drawn by horned beasts, and giant birds circle overhead.

On the highest precipice stands the scarred Asura Leader, his cloak fluttering in the wind behind him. Far off, Devlok's golden dome blinks out in the horizon.

Asur leader grins.

ASURA LEADER Devlok ki roshni bujh rahi hai.

An Asura Soldiers cheer.

ASURA SOLDIER Swarg ki shakti kamzor ho chuki hai.

The Leader turns to his army, red eyes burning.

ASURA LEADER Kitne barso se hum is pal ka intezaar kar rahe the?

The army slams weapons on shields.

He thrusts his warblade skyward giving out a war cry as the soldiers join his cheer.

The Asur leader flies his chariot towards Devlok seen in the horizon.

ASURA LEADER Aaj Swarg par hamla hoga!

## 1-4 — RAJ SABHA — CONTINUOUS / INT.

A WAR HORN blares echos from outside the Raj sabha doors. Every Devta's head snaps towards the door. Indra pushes himself up, mustering up energy.

INDRA Yeh awaaz…

Devta 1 rushes to the Raj sabha gate and looks out, his face drains. He turn to look inside the hall.

DEVTA 1 Asura sena! Swarg par hamla karne aa rahi hai!

Panic spreads. Devtas stumble and drop their shields. Devta 2 looks around for cover.

DEVTA 2 Humare paas apni shakti bhi nahi bachi!

Indra rushes to the center of the Raj Sabah and points at the entrance with authoritative stance.

INDRA Sabhi dwar band karo!

All Devtas rush and push the enormous golden doors inch by inch, hinges groaning. The horn sounds again, closer.

Airavata raises his head and roars, his wings spreads in the air.

INDRA Airavat!

Despite his dull hide and trembling limbs, Airavata flies to the gate and pushes it to shut with a lound and heavy imapact.

Gandaberunda spreads his wings, both heads grinning.

Devta 2 runs through Gandaberunda and feels nothing.

GANDABERUNDA Shri chali gayi. Devta kamzor ho gaye. Aur ab Asur bhi aa gaye, Humla karne

Durvasa walks to the window and sees the Asur army appearing at the horizon.

Gandaberunda flies next to durvasa.

GANDABERUNDA Dekh rhe ho Durvasa, bina shakti ke devtaye bhi surakshit nhi hai.

## 1-5 DEVLOK GATES - EVENING / EXT.

Through the gates, the Asura legions charge in with war cries.

HARD CUT TO BLACK.

The golden divine rivers turn into golden mist that rises into the air leaving behind a dead landscape.

The lotus in the pond dry up and turn into golden dust that scatters.

The golden waterways darken into black glass.

The gold from the monumental structures detaches and turns into golden dust energy that flows towards the Dev lok gates.

Devlok lies in unnatural shadow, its gold collapsed to slate-grey and dull bronze.

## 1-2 — RAJ SABHA — CONTINUOUS / INT.

Near the throne platform, Airavata's is sitting on the floor feeling restless, his head droops.

Indra steps toward him, hand hovering short of the trunk.

INDRA Airavat…ye kya ho rha hai tumhe

Airavata gives a strained rumble. His trunk rises weakly, then sags.

Indra then touches Airawat's crown. The central gem oh his ornament flickers and dies. The aghast Devtas look at Airawat in shock.

INDRA Ye maine kya anarth kar diya! Shri ke saath, Devlok ki saari shakti bhi ja rahi hai.

Devta 1 steps forward and raises his palm. A magical energy golden flame sputters from his palm and shrivels into grey smoke. He stares at his empty palm in subtle panic and fear.

DEVTA 1 Meri shakti… Meri shakti kahan chali gayi?

Beside him, Devta 2 shuts his eyes and chants silently. He opens his eyes, frightened.

DEVTA 2 Main apni divya shakti nahi jaga paa raha!"

Indra turns to Durvasa, trembling.

INDRA ((helpless)) Maharishi…Kripya kuch kijiye. Nhi toh mera ye Devlok, mere saare Devtao ki shakti nast ho jayegi.

All ten Devtas look to Durvasa, pleading.

From the gloom behind Durvasa, Gandaberunda manifests, black wings unfurling. Indra stumbles back looking at the monumental figure of gandaberunda..

GANDABERUNDA Har tabaahi ke liye…Shraap dena zaroori nahi hota, Devraj Indra

Indra stares in horror. The Devtas follow his gaze and see nothing, they look at each other feeling confused.

Indra stares at Gandaberunda as it approches him slowly.

INDRA ye kaun hai Maharishi, kahin isine aapko shraap dene ke liye toh nhi uksaya na

Gandaberunda laughs, rattling the chandeliers, then dissolves into the shadow behind Durvasa.

GANDABERUNDA Kitna bhi prayatna kar le Indra, Tumhara Devlok ab nhi bachega.

INDRA Maharishi…Meri baat suniye. Aapka apmaan karne ka iraada nahi tha mera. Mujhse galti hui hai.

Indra's gaze sweeps the ruin. Durvasa's follows: fallen diya lamps, Devtas slumped on the stairs, Airavata breathing heavily seated with his head drooping and ears flapping.

INDRA Lekin agar meri galti ki saza deni hai…toh mujhe dijiye. Devlok ko nahi.

GANDABERUNDA Sun raha hai, Durvasa? Indra khud maan raha hai ki galti hui hai.

INDRA ((joins hands towards Gandaberunda)) Bas kijiye, aap jo bhi hai...mein aapke haath joddta hun, aap kripya maun raheyea

Gandaberunda steps close to Indra. Indra shivers but sees nothing.

GANDABERUNDA Ab kis baat ka gussa, Indra? Jab Devlok ki roshni hi nahi bachi…toh tera rajya bhi kitni der bachega?

Indra's legs give out and he drops to the floor in front of Durvasa.

Durvasa looks up as the light coming through the large windwos.

DURVASA (V.O.) Ek pal ka Krodha…aur aaj poora Devlok uska bojh utha raha hai.

He glances at the ashes of the garland on the floor in front of him. A breeze carries it away.

DURVASA (V.O.) Maine apni Vani ko roka tha…par karm se kaun bach paya hai.

Gandaberunda smirks, his wings settling behind the sage like a second shadow.

## 1-3 — DARK MOUNTAIN / EXT.

Hundreds of thousands of Asuras stand in spiked armor with spears, maces and cleavers. Bone-plated chariots are drawn by horned beasts, and giant birds circle overhead.

On the highest precipice stands the scarred Asura Leader, his cloak fluttering in the wind behind him. Far off, Devlok's golden dome blinks out in the horizon.

Asur leader grins.

ASURA LEADER Devlok ki roshni bujh rahi hai.

An Asura Soldiers cheer.

ASURA SOLDIER Swarg ki shakti kamzor ho chuki hai.

The Leader turns to his army, red eyes burning.

ASURA LEADER Kitne barso se hum is pal ka intezaar kar rahe the?

The army slams weapons on shields.

He thrusts his warblade skyward giving out a war cry as the soldiers join his cheer.

The Asur leader flies his chariot towards Devlok seen in the horizon.

ASURA LEADER Aaj Swarg par hamla hoga!

## 1-4 — RAJ SABHA — CONTINUOUS / INT.

A WAR HORN blares echos from outside the Raj sabha doors. Every Devta's head snaps towards the door. Indra pushes himself up, mustering up energy.

INDRA Yeh awaaz…

Devta 1 rushes to the Raj sabha gate and looks out, his face drains. He turn to look inside the hall.

DEVTA 1 Asura sena! Swarg par hamla karne aa rahi hai!

Panic spreads. Devtas stumble and drop their shields. Devta 2 looks around for cover.

DEVTA 2 Humare paas apni shakti bhi nahi bachi!

Indra rushes to the center of the Raj Sabah and points at the entrance with authoritative stance.

INDRA Sabhi dwar band karo!

All Devtas rush and push the enormous golden doors inch by inch, hinges groaning. The horn sounds again, closer.

Airavata raises his head and roars, his wings spreads in the air.

INDRA Airavat!

GANDABERUNDA Shri chali gayi. Devta kamzor ho gaye. Aur ab Asur bhi aa gaye, Humla karne

Gandaberunda flies next to durvasa.

GANDABERUNDA Dekh rhe ho Durvasa, bina shakti ke devtaye bhi surakshit nhi hai.

1-1 — DEVLOK GATES — CONTINUOUS / EXT.

Characters : Durvasa, 10 Devtas, Devta 1 & 2, Indra, Airawat, Asura army, Asura soldier, Asura leader.

The roar of the charge dies into a heavy, tense silence outside the close gates of the Devlok. The huge Asura army spread across in large numbers.

Thousands of Asuras in spiked black iron hold spears, swords and heavy maces.

Behind them stand large dark war chariots, with horned beasts snorting steam into the crimson haze. Banners snap in the wind.

The asur leader on the war chariot is in the front parked infront of the closed Gate at a distance.

The Asura Leader slowly raises his sword. The blade catches a dull red light. He points it toward the closed golden Devlok Gate.

ASURA LEADER Devtaon, aaj tumhare saamne sirf Asur sena nahi, balki woh shakti khadi hai jo yugon se tumhare Swarg par adhikar karne ka intezaar kar rahi thi.

The Asura Leader lowers his sword.

ASURA LEADER Asuron, Devlok ke dwar tod do!

The first row of Asuras pulls their arms back in one motion. Hundreds of spears are thrown toward the closed golden gate.

The spears arc through the air and attack the monumental closed gates defending the city.

The guarding Devtas raise their large shields and brace, shoulders locked, heads ducked from safety from the falling spears.

CLANG! CLANG! CLANG!

The spears slam into the shields. Sparks fly. Some spears snap in half, and the splinters spin away. Others bounce off and clatter to the ground.

The Asuras rush toward the gate.

Their feet strike the ground with heavy force, and dust leaps from the earth with every step.

DHAM! DHAM! DHAM!

The Asuras continue attacking. The crack spreads across the entire gate, branching like a web. The upper part of the gate breaks. Large golden pieces fall to the ground.

The pillar breaks and falls, dust and golden fragments scattering across the floor.

DHADAAAM!

The main Devlok Gate collapses. Golden dust fills the entrance in a rolling cloud, and the guarding Devtas are forced to retreat, coughing and shielding their eyes from the flying rubble and dust.

Out of the dust, the Asura Leader walks through the broken entrance, the red haze behind him. Thousands of Asuras enter Devlok behind him, weapons raised, boots crunching on the golden rubble.

ASURA LEADER Devtaon, tumhara dwar toot chuka hai. Ab tumhara Swarg bhi hamara hoga.

The Asura army raises its weapons and charge through the broken gates towards the Devlok city.

1-2 — DEVLOK BATTLEFIELD — CONTINUOUS / EXT.

The Devtas stand shoulder to shoulder in a defensive line. Their golden armor is dull and scratched, and their shields are lowered in a defensive stance.

Indra stands at the center, Airawat weak but upright behind him Indra.

Devta 3 tightens his grip on his staff. Devta 4 shifts his mace to both hands nervously.

The asur army is seen arriving in large numbers at the horizon with their weapons raise.

Indra steps forward from the line and raises his Vajra toward the sky. The light flickers weakly along the Vajra as he raises it.

INDRA Apne sthaan se koi mat hatna. Yeh Devlok hai, aur jab tak mein iski raksha kar rahe hain, koi Asur is dwar ke paar nahi ja sakta.

The Devtas steady their feet and raise their weapons with a war cry.

Devta 1 lifts his mace with effort, and his arms tremble unable to handle the weight.

DEVTAS Jai Devraj Indra!

The first Asuras crash into the Devta line.

An Asura swings his sword in a heavy arc. A Devta blocks it with his shield.

CLANG!

Another Asura brings down a heavy mace. A Devta blocks it with his weapon, but the force drives him several steps backward, his sandals sliding on the marble.

Devta 1 blocks an asur soldier and steps backward in defence banging into Indra who is fighting another asur in the opposite side.

DEVTA 1 Devraj, inki sankhya bahut zyada hai!

Devta 1 is breathing hard, his shield arm shaking. Devta 2 beside him stumbles and is pulled upright by Indra.

INDRA Apni pankti mat chhodo! Sabhi Deva milkar inka saamna karo!

The Devtas attack together. Their weapons strike the Asuras, and the blows are visibly weaker than they should be.

The Asuras take the hits, stagger, and keep continuing the battle.

Indra looks at the Vajra, and his face becomes tense. Lightning forms around the Vajra, but it is thin and weak. It flickers and sputters around the weapon like a dying blue flame.

INDRA Shri ke Devlok se chale jaane ke baad… mere Vajra ki shakti bhi pehle jaisi nahi rahi.

The Asura Leader hears him across the clash. He throws his head back and laughs.

ASURA LEADER Toh yahi hai Devraj Indra ka Vajra? Jis Vajra se Devta teenon Lok par apna adhikar jatate the, aaj wahi Vajra khud apni roshni ke liye taras raha hai.

Indra looks at him angrily, jaw set.

INDRA Shakti kam hui hai, samapt nahi.

Indra hurls the Vajra toward the Asura army.

The vajra spins through the smoke and strikes the ground.

DHADAAAM!

A burst of lightning spreads across the earth in jagged white-blue veins. Several Asuras are thrown backward, their armor smoking. The Devtas cheer, weapons raised.

DEVTAS Jai Devraj!

The Vajra flies back rapidly into Indra's hand grab. The lightning around it turns weak again, and Indra's fingers tremble as he catches it.

Through the settling smoke, the Asura Leader slowly stands up. His armor is scorched but he is unhurt.

ASURA LEADER Devraj, tumne apni poori shakti laga di, aur phir bhi hum yahin khade hain.

He raises his sword.

ASURA LEADER Asuron, ab Devtaon ko unke Swarg ke andar tak peeche dhakel do!

The Asura leader charges towards Indra who defends with another strike.

Several Asuras swing their swords at the Devtas, and others attack with heavy maces.

A group of Asuras raises their hands, and dark fire forms in their palms, violet-black with a red core. They throw the dark fire toward the Devtas.

WHOOSH!

The fire hits the Devta shields.

BOOM! BOOM!

Several Devtas are thrown backward. One drops his weapon. Another falls hard to the ground. A third holds his injured arm, grimacing.

Devta 1 pulls a wounded young Devta behind a pillar.

DEVTA 2 Devraj, humari divya shakti bahut kam ho gayi hai. Hum inhe zyada der tak nahi rok sakte.

Indra watches the bloodied and exhausted devtas around him on the battlefield struggling to fight back.

Indra's expression becomes tense and determined.

INDRA Jab tak meri saans chal rahi hai, main Devlok ko in Asuron ke haath nahi jaane dunga.

An Asura attacks Indra with a sword. Indra blocks it with the Vajra.

CLANG!

Another Asura attacks from the side with a mace. Indra blocks it, but the impact pushes him backward, his boots dragging on the stone.

Airawat charges towards the asurs attacking Indra. He attacks the asura soldiers with his tusk freeing Indra, then tramples the asura soldier under his feet.

Indra raises his Vajra, blood on his temple and his crown crooked.

INDRA Devaon, sabhi mere peeche aa jao. Aakhri baar milkar war karte hai!

Airawat flies next to Indra, ready to battle.

All the Devtas gather behind Indra, limping and bruised.

The Asura Leader raises his sword above the smoke.

ASURA LEADER Asuron, Devtaon ki aakhri pankti tod do!"

The Asuras raise their weapons. Some raise swords. Some raise maces. Others gather dark fire in their hands.

The gathered Devtas take a defensive step backward, shields raised above their heads standing opposite the large army of the asuras.

ASURA ARMY : SWARG HAMARA HAI!

1-3 — DEVLOK BATTLEFIELD GOLDEN RIDGE — CONTINUOUS / EXT.

Far from the battlefield, Durvasa stands on a dark golden ridge overlooking the gate. He is holding the danda in his right hand and his robes flutters in the ash wind. He watches the battle far below unfolding at a distance.

The Devtas are loosing the battle with the asur army.

Indra in the middle of the field struggles to hold his Vajra as he leans agains a broken chariot to support himself.

Durvasa watches Indra from the far golden ridge.

Gandaberunda manifests behind Durvasa, forming out of dark dense fiery smoke that swirls up into his form. His huge black fiery wings spread behind him.

Durvasa and gandaberunda standing behind him on the golden ridge watch the battle.

GANDABERUNDA Dekh raha hai, Durvasa? Jis Devlok ko apni shakti par garv tha, aaj wahi Devta apne dwar tak nahi bacha paa rahe.

Durvasa silently watches without reacting to Gandaberunda.

GANDABERUNDA Dekh Indra ko. Uska Vajra, uske Devta sab kamzor hai. uska Swarg Asuron ke saamne toot raha hai.

Gandaberunda smiles, both beaks curving and comes to face Durvasa. Durvasa look up straight into Gandaberunda's eyes.

GANDABERUNDA Sirf ek Shraap. Aur yeh poori Asur sena bhasm ho sakti hai.

Devta 2 is chases by a group of Asur soldiers as he runs for his life.

Durvasa looks at the battlefield. His eyes become watery with sorrow.

GANDABERUNDA Ab bata, Durvasa… tera Maun Devlok ko kaise bachayega?

Durvasa looks at the far battlefield where few Devtas with lead by Indra and Airawat clash into the large army of the Asuras.

His eyes burn with suppressed anger.

HARD CUT TO BLACK.

Show: Maharishi Durvasa 2
Episode: EP14
Title: None

SCRIPT:
1-1 — DEVLOK GATES — CONTINUOUS / EXT.

Characters : Durvasa, 10 Devtas, Devta 1 & 2, Indra, Airawat, Asura army, Asura soldier, Asura leader.

The roar of the charge dies into a heavy, tense silence outside the close gates of the Devlok. The huge Asura army spread across in large numbers.

Thousands of Asuras in spiked black iron hold spears, swords and heavy maces.

Behind them stand large dark war chariots, with horned beasts snorting steam into the crimson haze. Banners snap in the wind.

The asur leader on the war chariot is in the front parked infront of the closed Gate at a distance.

The Asura Leader slowly raises his sword. The blade catches a dull red light. He points it toward the closed golden Devlok Gate.

ASURA LEADER Devtaon, aaj tumhare saamne sirf Asur sena nahi, balki woh shakti khadi hai jo yugon se tumhare Swarg par adhikar karne ka intezaar kar rahi thi.

The Asura Leader lowers his sword.

ASURA LEADER Asuron, Devlok ke dwar tod do!

The first row of Asuras pulls their arms back in one motion. Hundreds of spears are thrown toward the closed golden gate.

The spears arc through the air and attack the monumental closed gates defending the city.

The guarding Devtas raise their large shields and brace, shoulders locked, heads ducked from safety from the falling spears.

CLANG! CLANG! CLANG!

The spears slam into the shields. Sparks fly. Some spears snap in half, and the splinters spin away. Others bounce off and clatter to the ground.

The Asuras rush toward the gate.

Their feet strike the ground with heavy force, and dust leaps from the earth with every step.

DHAM! DHAM! DHAM!

The Asuras continue attacking. The crack spreads across the entire gate, branching like a web. The upper part of the gate breaks. Large golden pieces fall to the ground.

The pillar breaks and falls, dust and golden fragments scattering across the floor.

DHADAAAM!

The main Devlok Gate collapses. Golden dust fills the entrance in a rolling cloud, and the guarding Devtas are forced to retreat, coughing and shielding their eyes from the flying rubble and dust.

Out of the dust, the Asura Leader walks through the broken entrance, the red haze behind him. Thousands of Asuras enter Devlok behind him, weapons raised, boots crunching on the golden rubble.

ASURA LEADER Devtaon, tumhara dwar toot chuka hai. Ab tumhara Swarg bhi hamara hoga.

The Asura army raises its weapons and charge through the broken gates towards the Devlok city.

1-2 — DEVLOK BATTLEFIELD — CONTINUOUS / EXT.

The Devtas stand shoulder to shoulder in a defensive line. Their golden armor is dull and scratched, and their shields are lowered in a defensive stance.

Indra stands at the center, Airawat weak but upright behind him Indra.

Devta 3 tightens his grip on his staff. Devta 4 shifts his mace to both hands nervously.

The asur army is seen arriving in large numbers at the horizon with their weapons raise.

Indra steps forward from the line and raises his Vajra toward the sky. The light flickers weakly along the Vajra as he raises it.

INDRA Apne sthaan se koi mat hatna. Yeh Devlok hai, aur jab tak mein iski raksha kar rahe hain, koi Asur is dwar ke paar nahi ja sakta.

The Devtas steady their feet and raise their weapons with a war cry.

Devta 1 lifts his mace with effort, and his arms tremble unable to handle the weight.

DEVTAS Jai Devraj Indra!

The first Asuras crash into the Devta line.

An Asura swings his sword in a heavy arc. A Devta blocks it with his shield.

CLANG!

Another Asura brings down a heavy mace. A Devta blocks it with his weapon, but the force drives him several steps backward, his sandals sliding on the marble.

Devta 1 blocks an asur soldier and steps backward in defence banging into Indra who is fighting another asur in the opposite side.

DEVTA 1 Devraj, inki sankhya bahut zyada hai!

Devta 1 is breathing hard, his shield arm shaking. Devta 2 beside him stumbles and is pulled upright by Indra.

INDRA Apni pankti mat chhodo! Sabhi Deva milkar inka saamna karo!

The Devtas attack together. Their weapons strike the Asuras, and the blows are visibly weaker than they should be.

The Asuras take the hits, stagger, and keep continuing the battle.

Indra looks at the Vajra, and his face becomes tense. Lightning forms around the Vajra, but it is thin and weak. It flickers and sputters around the weapon like a dying blue flame.

INDRA Shri ke Devlok se chale jaane ke baad… mere Vajra ki shakti bhi pehle jaisi nahi rahi.

The Asura Leader hears him across the clash. He throws his head back and laughs.

ASURA LEADER Toh yahi hai Devraj Indra ka Vajra? Jis Vajra se Devta teenon Lok par apna adhikar jatate the, aaj wahi Vajra khud apni roshni ke liye taras raha hai.

Indra looks at him angrily, jaw set.

INDRA Shakti kam hui hai, samapt nahi.

Indra hurls the Vajra toward the Asura army.

The vajra spins through the smoke and strikes the ground.

DHADAAAM!

A burst of lightning spreads across the earth in jagged white-blue veins. Several Asuras are thrown backward, their armor smoking. The Devtas cheer, weapons raised.

DEVTAS Jai Devraj!

The Vajra flies back rapidly into Indra's hand grab. The lightning around it turns weak again, and Indra's fingers tremble as he catches it.

Through the settling smoke, the Asura Leader slowly stands up. His armor is scorched but he is unhurt.

ASURA LEADER Devraj, tumne apni poori shakti laga di, aur phir bhi hum yahin khade hain.

He raises his sword.

ASURA LEADER Asuron, ab Devtaon ko unke Swarg ke andar tak peeche dhakel do!

The Asura leader charges towards Indra who defends with another strike.

Several Asuras swing their swords at the Devtas, and others attack with heavy maces.

A group of Asuras raises their hands, and dark fire forms in their palms, violet-black with a red core. They throw the dark fire toward the Devtas.

WHOOSH!

The fire hits the Devta shields.

BOOM! BOOM!

Several Devtas are thrown backward. One drops his weapon. Another falls hard to the ground. A third holds his injured arm, grimacing.

Devta 1 pulls a wounded young Devta behind a pillar.

DEVTA 2 Devraj, humari divya shakti bahut kam ho gayi hai. Hum inhe zyada der tak nahi rok sakte.

Indra watches the bloodied and exhausted devtas around him on the battlefield struggling to fight back.

Indra's expression becomes tense and determined.

INDRA Jab tak meri saans chal rahi hai, main Devlok ko in Asuron ke haath nahi jaane dunga.

An Asura attacks Indra with a sword. Indra blocks it with the Vajra.

CLANG!

Another Asura attacks from the side with a mace. Indra blocks it, but the impact pushes him backward, his boots dragging on the stone.

Airawat charges towards the asurs attacking Indra. He attacks the asura soldiers with his tusk freeing Indra, then tramples the asura soldier under his feet.

Indra raises his Vajra, blood on his temple and his crown crooked.

INDRA Devaon, sabhi mere peeche aa jao. Aakhri baar milkar war karte hai!

Airawat flies next to Indra, ready to battle.

All the Devtas gather behind Indra, limping and bruised.

The Asura Leader raises his sword above the smoke.

ASURA LEADER Asuron, Devtaon ki aakhri pankti tod do!"

The Asuras raise their weapons. Some raise swords. Some raise maces. Others gather dark fire in their hands.

The gathered Devtas take a defensive step backward, shields raised above their heads standing opposite the large army of the asuras.

ASURA ARMY : SWARG HAMARA HAI!

1-3 — DEVLOK BATTLEFIELD GOLDEN RIDGE — CONTINUOUS / EXT.

Far from the battlefield, Durvasa stands on a dark golden ridge overlooking the gate. He is holding the danda in his right hand and his robes flutters in the ash wind. He watches the battle far below unfolding at a distance.

The Devtas are loosing the battle with the asur army.

Indra in the middle of the field struggles to hold his Vajra as he leans agains a broken chariot to support himself.

Durvasa watches Indra from the far golden ridge.

Gandaberunda manifests behind Durvasa, forming out of dark dense fiery smoke that swirls up into his form. His huge black fiery wings spread behind him.

Durvasa and gandaberunda standing behind him on the golden ridge watch the battle.

GANDABERUNDA Dekh raha hai, Durvasa? Jis Devlok ko apni shakti par garv tha, aaj wahi Devta apne dwar tak nahi bacha paa rahe.

Durvasa silently watches without reacting to Gandaberunda.

GANDABERUNDA Dekh Indra ko. Uska Vajra, uske Devta sab kamzor hai. uska Swarg Asuron ke saamne toot raha hai.

Gandaberunda smiles, both beaks curving and comes to face Durvasa. Durvasa look up straight into Gandaberunda's eyes.

GANDABERUNDA Sirf ek Shraap. Aur yeh poori Asur sena bhasm ho sakti hai.

Devta 2 is chases by a group of Asur soldiers as he runs for his life.

Durvasa looks at the battlefield. His eyes become watery with sorrow.

GANDABERUNDA Ab bata, Durvasa… tera Maun Devlok ko kaise bachayega?

Durvasa looks at the far battlefield where few Devtas with lead by Indra and Airawat clash into the large army of the Asuras.

His eyes burn with suppressed anger.

HARD CUT TO BLACK.

SCRIPT:
1-1 — DEVLOK GATES — CONTINUOUS / EXT.

Characters : Durvasa, 10 Devtas, Devta 1 & 2, Indra, Airawat, Asura army, Asura soldier, Asura leader.

The roar of the charge dies into a heavy, tense silence outside the close gates of the Devlok. The huge Asura army spread across in large numbers.

Thousands of Asuras in spiked black iron hold spears, swords and heavy maces.

Behind them stand large dark war chariots, with horned beasts snorting steam into the crimson haze. Banners snap in the wind.

The asur leader on the war chariot is in the front parked infront of the closed Gate at a distance.

The Asura Leader slowly raises his sword. The blade catches a dull red light. He points it toward the closed golden Devlok Gate.

ASURA LEADER Devtaon, aaj tumhare saamne sirf Asur sena nahi, balki woh shakti khadi hai jo yugon se tumhare Swarg par adhikar karne ka intezaar kar rahi thi.

The Asura Leader lowers his sword.

ASURA LEADER Asuron, Devlok ke dwar tod do!

The first row of Asuras pulls their arms back in one motion. Hundreds of spears are thrown toward the closed golden gate.

The spears arc through the air and attack the monumental closed gates defending the city.

The guarding Devtas raise their large shields and brace, shoulders locked, heads ducked from safety from the falling spears.

CLANG! CLANG! CLANG!

The spears slam into the shields. Sparks fly. Some spears snap in half, and the splinters spin away. Others bounce off and clatter to the ground.

The Asuras rush toward the gate.

Their feet strike the ground with heavy force, and dust leaps from the earth with every step.

DHAM! DHAM! DHAM!

The Asuras continue attacking. The crack spreads across the entire gate, branching like a web. The upper part of the gate breaks. Large golden pieces fall to the ground.

The pillar breaks and falls, dust and golden fragments scattering across the floor.

DHADAAAM!

The main Devlok Gate collapses. Golden dust fills the entrance in a rolling cloud, and the guarding Devtas are forced to retreat, coughing and shielding their eyes from the flying rubble and dust.

Out of the dust, the Asura Leader walks through the broken entrance, the red haze behind him. Thousands of Asuras enter Devlok behind him, weapons raised, boots crunching on the golden rubble.

ASURA LEADER Devtaon, tumhara dwar toot chuka hai. Ab tumhara Swarg bhi hamara hoga.

The Asura army raises its weapons and charge through the broken gates towards the Devlok city.

1-2 — DEVLOK BATTLEFIELD — CONTINUOUS / EXT.

The Devtas stand shoulder to shoulder in a defensive line. Their golden armor is dull and scratched, and their shields are lowered in a defensive stance.

Indra stands at the center, Airawat weak but upright behind him Indra.

Devta 3 tightens his grip on his staff. Devta 4 shifts his mace to both hands nervously.

The asur army is seen arriving in large numbers at the horizon with their weapons raise.

Indra steps forward from the line and raises his Vajra toward the sky. The light flickers weakly along the Vajra as he raises it.

INDRA Apne sthaan se koi mat hatna. Yeh Devlok hai, aur jab tak mein iski raksha kar rahe hain, koi Asur is dwar ke paar nahi ja sakta.

The Devtas steady their feet and raise their weapons with a war cry.

Devta 1 lifts his mace with effort, and his arms tremble unable to handle the weight.

DEVTAS Jai Devraj Indra!

The first Asuras crash into the Devta line.

An Asura swings his sword in a heavy arc. A Devta blocks it with his shield.

CLANG!

Another Asura brings down a heavy mace. A Devta blocks it with his weapon, but the force drives him several steps backward, his sandals sliding on the marble.

Devta 1 blocks an asur soldier and steps backward in defence banging into Indra who is fighting another asur in the opposite side.

DEVTA 1 Devraj, inki sankhya bahut zyada hai!

Devta 1 is breathing hard, his shield arm shaking. Devta 2 beside him stumbles and is pulled upright by Indra.

INDRA Apni pankti mat chhodo! Sabhi Deva milkar inka saamna karo!

The Devtas attack together. Their weapons strike the Asuras, and the blows are visibly weaker than they should be.

The Asuras take the hits, stagger, and keep continuing the battle.

Indra looks at the Vajra, and his face becomes tense. Lightning forms around the Vajra, but it is thin and weak. It flickers and sputters around the weapon like a dying blue flame.

INDRA Shri ke Devlok se chale jaane ke baad… mere Vajra ki shakti bhi pehle jaisi nahi rahi.

The Asura Leader hears him across the clash. He throws his head back and laughs.

ASURA LEADER Toh yahi hai Devraj Indra ka Vajra? Jis Vajra se Devta teenon Lok par apna adhikar jatate the, aaj wahi Vajra khud apni roshni ke liye taras raha hai.

Indra looks at him angrily, jaw set.

INDRA Shakti kam hui hai, samapt nahi.

Indra hurls the Vajra toward the Asura army.

The vajra spins through the smoke and strikes the ground.

DHADAAAM!

A burst of lightning spreads across the earth in jagged white-blue veins. Several Asuras are thrown backward, their armor smoking. The Devtas cheer, weapons raised.

DEVTAS Jai Devraj!

The Vajra flies back rapidly into Indra's hand grab. The lightning around it turns weak again, and Indra's fingers tremble as he catches it.

Through the settling smoke, the Asura Leader slowly stands up. His armor is scorched but he is unhurt.

ASURA LEADER Devraj, tumne apni poori shakti laga di, aur phir bhi hum yahin khade hain.

He raises his sword.

ASURA LEADER Asuron, ab Devtaon ko unke Swarg ke andar tak peeche dhakel do!

The Asura leader charges towards Indra who defends with another strike.

Several Asuras swing their swords at the Devtas, and others attack with heavy maces.

A group of Asuras raises their hands, and dark fire forms in their palms, violet-black with a red core. They throw the dark fire toward the Devtas.

WHOOSH!

The fire hits the Devta shields.

BOOM! BOOM!

Several Devtas are thrown backward. One drops his weapon. Another falls hard to the ground. A third holds his injured arm, grimacing.

Devta 1 pulls a wounded young Devta behind a pillar.

DEVTA 2 Devraj, humari divya shakti bahut kam ho gayi hai. Hum inhe zyada der tak nahi rok sakte.

Indra watches the bloodied and exhausted devtas around him on the battlefield struggling to fight back.

Indra's expression becomes tense and determined.

INDRA Jab tak meri saans chal rahi hai, main Devlok ko in Asuron ke haath nahi jaane dunga.

An Asura attacks Indra with a sword. Indra blocks it with the Vajra.

CLANG!

Another Asura attacks from the side with a mace. Indra blocks it, but the impact pushes him backward, his boots dragging on the stone.

Airawat charges towards the asurs attacking Indra. He attacks the asura soldiers with his tusk freeing Indra, then tramples the asura soldier under his feet.

Indra raises his Vajra, blood on his temple and his crown crooked.

INDRA Devaon, sabhi mere peeche aa jao. Aakhri baar milkar war karte hai!

Airawat flies next to Indra, ready to battle.

All the Devtas gather behind Indra, limping and bruised.

The Asura Leader raises his sword above the smoke.

ASURA LEADER Asuron, Devtaon ki aakhri pankti tod do!"

The Asuras raise their weapons. Some raise swords. Some raise maces. Others gather dark fire in their hands.

The gathered Devtas take a defensive step backward, shields raised above their heads standing opposite the large army of the asuras.

ASURA ARMY : SWARG HAMARA HAI!

1-3 — DEVLOK BATTLEFIELD GOLDEN RIDGE — CONTINUOUS / EXT.

Far from the battlefield, Durvasa stands on a dark golden ridge overlooking the gate. He is holding the danda in his right hand and his robes flutters in the ash wind. He watches the battle far below unfolding at a distance.

The Devtas are loosing the battle with the asur army.

Indra in the middle of the field struggles to hold his Vajra as he leans agains a broken chariot to support himself.

Durvasa watches Indra from the far golden ridge.

Gandaberunda manifests behind Durvasa, forming out of dark dense fiery smoke that swirls up into his form. His huge black fiery wings spread behind him.

Durvasa and gandaberunda standing behind him on the golden ridge watch the battle.

GANDABERUNDA Dekh raha hai, Durvasa? Jis Devlok ko apni shakti par garv tha, aaj wahi Devta apne dwar tak nahi bacha paa rahe.

Durvasa silently watches without reacting to Gandaberunda.

GANDABERUNDA Dekh Indra ko. Uska Vajra, uske Devta sab kamzor hai. uska Swarg Asuron ke saamne toot raha hai.

Gandaberunda smiles, both beaks curving and comes to face Durvasa. Durvasa look up straight into Gandaberunda's eyes.

GANDABERUNDA Sirf ek Shraap. Aur yeh poori Asur sena bhasm ho sakti hai.

Devta 2 is chases by a group of Asur soldiers as he runs for his life.

Durvasa looks at the battlefield. His eyes become watery with sorrow.

GANDABERUNDA Ab bata, Durvasa… tera Maun Devlok ko kaise bachayega?

Durvasa looks at the far battlefield where few Devtas with lead by Indra and Airawat clash into the large army of the Asuras.

His eyes burn with suppressed anger.

HARD CUT TO BLACK.
